title: Retire the overview tool once a template release covers Proposal 4
goal: tools/solution-overview*.mjs, their tests, check:order, solution:overview and docs/SOLUTION-OVERVIEW.md are gone; the dashboard is the owner's view
acceptance: Reconcile to the release that covers Proposal 4, compare both views on the same commits, then remove the project tool, its tests, scripts, CI steps and generated view
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Component repositories are read, never written.
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: reconcile, compare, delete the tool and its references, refresh; depends on a template release that does not exist yet, so this can grow. Not a measurement. Done 2026-11-25: reconciled to 10.21.1 and compared `solution.mjs dashboard --remote` with the overview on the same component commits (nerv 9db5bf8, gauntlet-protocol 2339e41, project-harness 5b1fd43, fpvbuddy 9ba5e86, grover 14dfdff): summary counts, runway (116 h), owner hours (27.75 h), Nothing to do and the 43 Waiting-for-the-owner rows agree once coordinator:F-006-T01 and coordinator:F-007-T01 carry their cross-repository dependsOn. Differences kept by the template on purpose: ▶ skips items that only await verification; Blocked names the first owner step; unstated owner hours read —. Other differences, reported to the owner, not fixed here: an order item with ready agent work and an owner step reads Ready, not Owner (nerv:F-016, so ▶ is nerv:F-016); a scoped audit does not count (solution, grover: no complete full audit, next 2026-12-01 against 2026-12-02); no per-record open-work table with state and next action (open steps only, collapsed, without state); the gap review is not numbered; this repository reads solution, not coordinator. Retired the overview tool, its tests, fixtures, scripts, CI steps and page; the refresh guard reads the 10.21 order table. Actual stated, not measured. Review: design-reviewer in a fresh context on PR #39, no blockers; its one should-fix (the guard kept the order columns past the order table) fixed with a test.
